verdict.rationale: Box's REST API (box-docs-1, box-docs-17) is fully token/OAuth-based and scriptable via curl, and a CLI is mentioned (box-docs-27), both of which support headless/automated use in CI pipelines. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD integration patterns, service-account/machine-to-machine auth flows, or example pipeline configs. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/headless automation guide, service-account auth documentation, and independent corroboration of running Box API calls in automated pipelines.
